column3: The Mortgaged Property is security for 9 senior pari passu notes aggregating $551,250,000 and 3 subordinate notes aggregating $23,750,000, totaling $575,000,000. The borrower has a leasehold interest in the Mortgaged Property pursuant to two ground leases: (i) a ground lease from Hillsborough County Aviation Authority for Parcel 1, comprising the majority of the mortgaged property, and (ii) a ground lease from IP Land Associates LLC for Parcel E, comprising the spaces currently occupied by Crate & Barrel and Ocean Prime. Both ground leases expire on December 31, 2080, with no extension options. The ground lessor has a right of first refusal (ROFR) if the ground lessee sells or assigns its interest in the leased premised. The ROFR is not extinguished by foreclosure; however, the ROFR does not apply to any assignment to or by any leasehold mortgagee or its nominee, or pursuant to a foreclosure or deed in lieu thereof.

The Mortgaged Property is comprised of 22 self-storage properties that are security for 4 pari passu notes aggregating $140,000,000. With respect to the 5706 Georgetown property, Georgetown, TX (having an allocated loan amount of $5,798,000 or 3.9% of the allocated Whole Loan amount), the Mortgaged Property is one unit in a three-unit condominium regime. The borrower’s voting rights interest in the owners’ association is 74.3%, affording the borrower effective operating control of the association.

JP Morgan Chase Bank (out-parcel tenant) has a one-time Right of First Refusal (ROFR) to purchase the mortgaged property if the borrower receives an offer as to the related out-parcel that it is otherwise willing to accept. The ROFR is not extinguished by foreclosure; however, the ROFR does not apply to foreclosure or deed in lieu thereof.
